nome: K_7(9,4): base de classes laterais + remendo
texto: Upper bound search for a covering code: union of cosets of a linear [9,3] code over Z_7 (syndrome method), orphan syndromes left uncovered, plus a patch of extra words; patch forced invariant under translation along a line of the linear code (orbits of size 7); integer linear programming with imposed symmetry group; minimizing the number of codewords so that every word of (Z/7)^9 is within Hamming distance 4.

Unicost set cover / hitting set: cover a residual set of points by Hamming balls with as few balls as possible; local search heuristics (row weighting local search, configuration checking), randomized greedy, iterated greedy; combinatorial optimization on hypergraphs.

Table of 1145 parameter cells of upper and lower bounds for covering numbers K_q(n,R); propagation of proven inequalities between cells (monotonicity, direct sum, amalgamation) to a fixed point; detecting contradictions and implied exact values; provenance states from claimed to formalized.

Lean 4 kernel-checked certificates of finite combinatorial statements: an explicit list of words and a decidable check that every point of a finite space is within radius R; syndrome-based certificates; no native_decide; axioms audit (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound); trusted statement separated from proof, adversarial red team of the statement.

Exhaustive isomorph-free generation (canonical augmentation, orderly generation, nauty canonical labeling of colored graphs) to classify all optimal codes up to equivalence and prove nonexistence for small parameters; symmetry group wreath product S_q wr S_n acting on coordinates and symbols.

nome: lema das fibras + CNF com LRAT
texto: Nonexistence proofs by a fiber lemma: projections onto coordinate pairs give finite profiles; each profile is encoded as a CNF satisfiability instance and refuted with an LRAT proof checked by two independent checkers; exact value of a covering number from SAT unsatisfiability certificates.

nome: fatia mínima, LP e certificados de Farkas
texto: Reduction of a covering existence problem to many pseudo-Boolean instances (minimum slice); linear programming relaxation kills every instance with an integer Farkas infeasibility certificate; cutting planes solver with VeriPB proof logging; ladder of human-readable lemmas replacing opaque dual certificates.

Group action of the wreath product S_3 wr S_6 on Z_3^6; enumeration of instances up to symmetry, orbit counting, canonical forms via nauty colored graphs and an independent implementation; independent reproduction of a nonexistence result.

Football pool problem: ternary covering code of length 6 and radius 1; decomposition into subproblems (Linderoth–Margot–Thain), orbit representatives under a group of order 72, lex-leader symmetry breaking, SAT and pseudo-Boolean solving with proofs, measured cost extrapolation.

Explicit block constructions for covering codes with radius n-2 using partitions of the alphabet and families of blocks; structure of a small optimal code and its generalization to an infinite family of parameters.

nome: cotas inferiores por LP/SDP com dual racional
texto: Lower bounds for covering codes by linear and semidefinite programming (Delsarte-type bounds, Schrijver/Gijswijt–Polak semidefinite bounds, Lovasz theta-type relaxations) with a rational dual certificate checked exactly and then formalized.

Exact verifier for the covering radius of an explicit code (brute force, union of balls, breadth-first search), independent implementations in different languages, mutation testing that must fail; verifying is far cheaper than searching.
Systematic literature sweep over the citation graph of covering code sources and novelty checking of new bounds before publication; provenance of every number.
Integer factorization with the general number field sieve; measuring computationally redundant information in relation collection and sieving; compression of the work; lattice-based factoring claims.

nome: escada J_1..J_ℓ em isomorfismo de grafos (dono, sem arquivo no repo)
texto: A ladder of increasingly strong graph invariants J_1, ..., J_l used to distinguish non-isomorphic graphs (graph isomorphism testing, color refinement); needs a library of adversarial pairs of non-isomorphic graphs that are hard to distinguish, to measure how deep the ladder must go.

nome: reconstrução por decks (dono, sem arquivo no repo)
texto: Reconstruction of a finite object (graph, code, set of words) from its deck of substructures obtained by deleting one element at a time; how much information is necessary to reconstruct or to distinguish a finite object; reconstruction conjecture.

nome: matrizes de Hadamard (dono, sem arquivo no repo)
texto: Hadamard matrices: square plus/minus one matrices with orthogonal rows; existence for orders divisible by four, constructions (Paley, Sylvester, Williamson), equivalence classes, conference matrices.

nome: números de Schur (dono, sem arquivo no repo)
texto: Schur numbers: partitions of 1..N into k sum-free sets, colorings avoiding monochromatic solutions of x + y = z, Ramsey-type numbers computed with SAT solvers and symmetry breaking.

nome: somas iguais de potências / Euler (dono, sem arquivo no repo)
texto: Equal sums of like powers: counterexamples to Euler's sum of powers conjecture, Prouhet–Tarry–Escott problem, Diophantine search for small solutions.

nome: quociente de estado / C-FLUXO (dono, sem arquivo no repo)
texto: Minimal quotient of a state space that preserves observable behaviour: how much information must be retained to distinguish states or reconstruct an object; bisimulation, automaton minimization, information-theoretic compression of state.

Registry of open problems as cards with a lifecycle state machine; claims advance only with evidence from an exact evaluator or the proof assistant kernel; provenance and reproducibility of computer-assisted results.
